turns.input: Mistress Elara gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Mistress Elara withdraws a pair of leather boots from somewhere within her elegant attire and extends them toward Nicco with a small, assessing smile. "You stand at Heartstone's door with a certain bearing," she says, her tone light but her green-hazel eyes watching his reaction with evident interest. "A practical gift. One notices these things."

Nicco accepts the boots from her hands.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"Need them more than you?" Mistress Elara's fan pauses mid-gesture, and she laughs—a light, musical sound that draws a glance from a passing tradesman. "My dear man, I own more shoes than I have fingers to count them, and every pair made to my measure." She studies him with green-hazel eyes that miss little, the toe of one silk-slippered foot visible beneath her hem. "But you—standing there in whatever you've walked through to reach this door—clearly do not."

She makes no move to accept the offered boots. "Keep them. Consider it an introduction, if you prefer. Though I confess curiosity: one doesn't often encounter a man at Heartstone who refuses leather and admits freely that others might need it more." A slight, knowing smile plays at her lips. "Are you always so careless with your advantages, or is this particular to the day?"
